sector_size.description: Sector size in bytes (e.g., 512, 4096); must be a positive integer

max_heads.description: Maximum heads per cylinder for CHS/LBA conversion (positive integer, e.g., 16, 255)

max_sectors.description: Maximum sectors per track for CHS/LBA conversion (positive integer, e.g., 63, 64)

use_calc.description: Use calc(1) instead of bc(1) for non-storage arithmetic

minimal_output.description: Enable minimal output mode (decimal bytes only)

expressions.description: List of bcal expressions to evaluate (one-shot mode) — each expression is a quoted string per bcal(1) synopsis
